data.scope: Frozen source identities and verbatim upstream notice texts for Monaco/vConsole. This is not clearance of all bundled components, the console bundle, fonts, media or other site assets.

groups.name: vconsole
groups.review: The 3.15.0 upstream LICENSE declares MIT but omits the promised full license text. The copied file preserves this upstream evidence; completeness and bundled dependency notices remain under review.

groups.name: monaco-editor
groups.review: The upstream Monaco LICENSE and ThirdPartyNotices are retained in full. The included codicon.ttf still needs matching Codicons version/attribution evidence; the Monaco package license alone does not close that font review.

browser.scope: Three desktop TypeScript worker cases passed; mobile console Chromium/Firefox passed, WebKit failed after destruction with an unhandled store update. Runtime vendor bytes unchanged. Test title later corrected from complete notices to upstream notice texts; assertions unchanged.

upstreamVconsole.limitation: Upstream notice contains MIT declaration but no promised license body; dependency notice completeness remains open. RAF/store path is a candidate cause, not yet proven by a minimal reproduction.

limitations: SITE-07 is doing; console bundle, font/media permissions, vConsole license completeness and destruction remain open.
No complete new Pages artifact build, physical-device validation or deployment was performed.
Package or manifest license names alone are not treated as full license evidence.

VENDOR-06 remains open: exact bundled Codicons font version and its separate license/attribution evidence are not supplied by the Monaco LICENSE/ThirdPartyNotices files. Current https://github.com/microsoft/vscode-codicons distinguishes CC-BY-4.0 content from MIT code; historical font mapping still required.
